description: Canonical structuredContent shape returned by the search_papers MCP tool. Frozen by E06_S04; bumped at E13_S02 to widen snippet.maxLength for the <retrieved_chunk> delimiter wrapping (Threat 2 defense). Bumped at proof-verify-handler-wiring-m1 for paper_id filter wiring (Field description change; output shape unchanged). Bumped at proof-verify-handler-wiring-m2 to add the optional filters_applied echo field. Bumped at verification-feedback-m1 (and again at its rectification) to track the TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise for the cite_neighbors handler wiring (this search_papers result shape is unchanged — the version field tracks server.tools.TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION globally). Bumped at verification-feedback-m3 (11 -> 12) to track the lean_verify tool addition; this search_papers result shape is unchanged. Bumped at textbook-ingest-m3 (12 -> 13) to track the SEARCH_PAPERS ToolMeta description edit that documented the textbook:<slug> paper_id form in filters validation; the result-row shape is unchanged (the textbook chunk_id pattern was already widened at textbook-ingest-m1 via the chunk_id.pattern mirror below). Bumped at textbook-ingest-m9 / e4 (13 -> 14) to ADD the per-row source_kind enum property (arxiv|textbook) + its required entry — the first result-row SHAPE change of the textbook family. Bumped again at textbook-ingest-m9 / e4 rectification (14 -> 15) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the critique-F3 filters-parameter inputSchema description fix; this result-row shape is unchanged at the 14 -> 15 step. The byte-stability test in E06_S06 hashes this file's bytes and pins the SHA-256; any drift is a deliberate bump. The ``version`` field below MUST equal server.tools.TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION (cross-checked by tests/test_snippet_contract.py).

corpus_version.description: The integer corpus_version pinned at server startup (per E04_S03's corpus-version.json marker). Echoed in every tool result envelope so the agent can correlate cached results.

embed_model.description: Identifier of the embedding model used at retrieval time. v1: 'bge-m3'. Pinned constant — bumps invalidate downstream caches.

excluded_kinds.description: Chunk kinds NOT included in the result set. v1: ['proof'] — the dual-encoding schema puts proof bodies in embedding_proof which is not yet retrievable until E07's dual-column RRF lands. Programmatic detector for the v1 limitation.

filter_warnings.description: Human-readable warnings about filter / cursor args that were accepted but not yet processed. v1 ignores the filters and cursor args (deferred to E07_S04); when set, this array carries one string per ignored arg.

filters_applied.description: Echo of the filter actually honored by this call. Absent when no filter was passed. Only contains keys from server.handlers.search.SUPPORTED_FILTER_KEYS (currently: paper_id). The paper_id list is sorted and coerced to list[str] per server.handlers.search._canonicalize_filters. Downstream agents use this to verify scoping without re-parsing filter_warnings. Added at proof-verify-handler-wiring-m2.

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results. v1: always null (pagination deferred to E07_S04).

results.description: Per-chunk result rows, sorted (score_desc, chunk_id_asc). Each row is the canonical search-result object frozen by this milestone.

items.description: One search result. NOT a chunk — agents call get_chunk(chunk_id) to fetch the full body. The snippet content is a byte-for-byte slice of body_text (max 150 chars of content), no LLM rewriting. The snippet field itself wraps the content in <retrieved_chunk>...</retrieved_chunk> delimiters per Threat-2 defense (E13_S02; .claude/docs/security-threat-2-audit.md). The wrap adds 35 chars of fixed overhead plus up to 6 chars per literal delimiter occurrence escaped in the body — maxLength: 250 covers the worst case.

chunk_id.description: Content-addressable chunk_id. Two prefix shapes (textbook-ingest-m1): arxiv:<paper_id>:<16-hex> for arXiv chunks and textbook:<slug>:<16-hex> for notebook-scoped textbook chunks. Stable across re-chunks of the same source bytes. Pattern mirrors ingest.identifiers.CHUNK_ID_PATTERN (single source of truth, locked by tests/test_snippet_contract.py::TestRegexSourceOfTruth).

label.description: Human-readable theorem label (e.g. 'Theorem 3.4'). Built from theorem_name + theorem_label. Empty string when neither is populated.

paper_id.description: Paper identifier without source prefix. Two shapes (textbook-ingest-m1 + m3): (a) arXiv — e.g. '2401.00001' or 'hep-th/9876543', optionally with a 'vN' version suffix; (b) textbook — 'textbook:<slug>' where <slug> matches the notebook-slug regex [a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}. The chunk_id field above pins the canonical regex for both branches.

score.description: Cosine similarity in [0.0, 1.0] (computed as 1 - L2_distance / 2 over L2-normalized BGE-M3 vectors). Higher is more similar.

section_path.description: Section breadcrumb from the chunk's source paper (e.g. ['Section 3', 'Subsection 3.1']). Empty list when the chunk has no section context.

snippet.description: First 150 characters of the chunk's canonical body text (column body_text in the LanceDB chunks table; conceptually body_canonical per design note 04), wrapped in <retrieved_chunk>...</retrieved_chunk> delimiters as a prompt-injection defense (E13_S02 Threat 2). Open and close tag occurrences inside the body content are HTML-escaped before wrapping (escape-on-emit). NO LLM rewriting, NO ellipsis. Agents that need the full body call get_chunk(chunk_id). The 150-char limit applies to the content INSIDE the delimiter; the field's maxLength of 250 accommodates 17-char open tag + up to 198 chars of escaped content + 18-char close tag.

source_kind.description: Origin corpus of the chunk (textbook-ingest-m9 / e4). 'arxiv' for shared-corpus / arXiv-paper chunks; 'textbook' for notebook-scoped textbook chunks (MinerU+LaTeXML pipeline). Mirrors the chunks-table source_kind enum column. Filterable via filters.source_kind in the search_papers request.

retrieval_mode.description: Active retrieval mode. v1: 'dense_only' (BGE-M3 ANN over embedding_stmt). E07 will add 'hybrid_rrf' when BM25 + RRF lands; later 'hybrid_rrf_reranked' once the BGE-reranker is wired.
